ai.title: AI
ai.keySaved: API key saved (encrypted on this computer).
ai.keyHint: Keys are encrypted with your system keychain and never leave the main process.
ai.thinkingHint: How much the model thinks before answering, for models that can reason. Higher is slower and uses more tokens; the levels only change the effort on models that support them (gpt-oss), others are simply on or off.
ai.maxIterationsHint: How many times the AI may call tools and look at the result for one request.

cap.noTools: Cannot call tools, so it cannot make changes for the agents

ai.noProvider: Add an Ollama Cloud API key (or another provider) in Settings to use the AI.
ai.clearHint: Forget this conversation (the style brief is kept).
ai.emptyEditor: Ask for a change, for example: "rotate 90° left and add flames at the tip".
ai.sendHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line, Up/Down for earlier messages

proposal.title: Proposed plan ({count} steps)
proposal.dependencyWarning: {count} kept step(s) were computed on top of a step you unchecked; the result may differ from the preview.
proposal.applied: Applied {count} step(s) to the texture. Save to keep it.

eval.title: Test models
eval.hint: Sends the French and English test phrases to each chosen model and checks that it picks the right tools. Choose several models to compare them side by side. Uses your provider tokens: 18 phrases per model for the quick test, 72 for the full test.
eval.stopped: Test stopped before the end; the scores cover only what ran.
eval.good: Good fit: {rate} % of requests mapped to the right tools in both languages.
eval.weak: Weak fit: only {rate} % of requests mapped to the right tools. The agent may misread some requests with this model.
eval.stats: Average {latency} ms per request. Tokens: {input} in, {output} out.
eval.weakGap: Uneven fit: {gap} points between French and English. The agent may misread requests in one of the languages.
eval.compareHint: Best first: highest overall score, then the smallest French/English gap, then the lowest cost.

reasoning.tooltip: Reasoning level for this tab (the default is in Settings)

ai.baseUrlHint: For OpenAI-compatible servers, include the version, for example https://api.example.com/v1.
ai.extraHeadersHint: Optional, one per line as Name: value. Never put your API key here.
ai.invalidHeaders: Each line must look like Name: value.
ai.agentLater: This agent arrives in a later version; the defaults you choose here will be used then.

models.title: Models
models.hint: Every model your providers offer, with what it can do and its price. Adjust a model when its provider gets it wrong or gives no price.
models.tiers: Cost tiers ($ per 1M tokens: $ below, $$$ above)
models.tiersHint: Blended price per million tokens (one part input, three parts output): $ under ${low}, $$ up to ${high}, $$$ above. Models without a known price show no tier.
models.showAll: Also offer models that cannot call tools
models.yourPriceHint: Input and output prices; leave empty to use the provider price or the estimate.
